integrity: Each boundary rank is computed by exhaustive deterministic binary Gaussian elimination, repeated under two distinct reference-half-edge conventions; Gal Euler characteristic checks the result.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite weight-four reduced Swiatkowski chain computation over F2 for unordered B_4(K_5,5); no integral splitting, general K_{a,b} formula, cycle basis, or independent validation is claimed.
title: Mod-two homology of four unordered points on \(K_{5,5}\)
